title: DumbEvents
description: A server where a big variety of minigames are randomized
body: The server cycles through a game pool of a big variety of minigames. There's a bunch of maps as well including community built ones. If you're looking for something unique, addictive and fun well this server might be for you. We have a decently active player-base as well. We have voice-chat as well via the Simple Voice Chat mod
